candidates.fit: True 1-channel 12-bit SAR, separate VREF pin (0.25V-VDD, independent of VDD), best INL grade (B) AND best stock AND lowest price in the whole MCP320x family - no tradeoff needed.
Same SAR core and separate-VREF architecture as MCP3201, 4 channels (use 1). Second-source/spare-channel hedge, not a reason to prefer over #1 for a single-channel need.

Best stock/speed/native-3.3V-supply of any candidate (1 MSPS, AVDD 1.65-3.6V), on-chip offset self-cal - but has NO external reference pin at all; full-scale = AVDD directly, so hitting 0.1% needs AVDD itself to be a precision rail.

CAUTION: cheapest/best-stocked family member, but its 8-pin package ties VDD and VREF to the SAME physical pin (datasheet-confirmed) - cannot accept a true external sub-VDD reference despite the catalog listing Voltage Reference = External.

Answers the exceeds-own-supply question: 16-bit SAR with an on-chip attenuator, software input range 0-5.12V (near-exact fit, no board attenuator needed) - but AVDD is fixed ~5V (4.75-5.25V), incompatible with this board's 3.3V-only rail as stated. Flagged, not recommended, per instructions.
1-ch 12-bit 1MSPS SAR, good typ INL/DNL (0.8/0.3 LSB) - but thin stock, ~5x MCP3201 price, and catalog shows internal-reference-only (no confirmed external-ref override). Low-priority backup only.
